description.content: Creates a new TWAP (Time-Weighted Average Price) order. The order is split into child orders placed at regular intervals over the specified running time. Running time must be between 5 minutes and 24 hours and a multiple of the frequency. The number of child orders (runningTime / frequency) must be between 2 and 200.
